about: The Market Board's data (Docs/Design/79-a-staged-economy.md, 5 and 7; Core/RatwMarket.cpp). `groups`: each good's depth group and its depthBase (a market's depth for a good is max(20, depthBase x catchment^0.6) x depthScale). A good's group is its entry in `goods`, else its catalogue category's in `categories`, else `fallback`. `district`: a static price factor by a keeper's quarter (its voice table's `quarter`), by group or `all`, inside the clamp. `times`: the slider's narrow move on staples and luxuries (D2), at hard, lean, ordinary, good and boom. `seasonSpanMost`: a season group's price swing (its dearest season over its cheapest) is rescaled to at most this, so it fits the clamp with room for pressure (the user, 2026-11-08: at a season's ends, with the region factors, players' pressure always keeps at least x1.10 up and x0.90 down inside the clamp, for every good; 1.06 leaves x1.136 up and x0.893 down; market_tests' seasonsLeavePressureRoom pins it). `region`: dearer where a good isn't made. `buys`: what a kind of shop also buys from players in the staged economy (D5: the smithy, the ironworks and the foundry buy iron ore). `shelves`: a ware's shelf where it isn't the starting stock (4, swords 3; moved from city_loop.json: theriac, the apothecary's rare cure-all, one at a time). `seasons`: the seven season groups (moved from city_loop.json, gone since doc 79's Phase 3): each group's goods and, for Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter (each the value at the season's middle day, the days between blended), in percent of normal, its `price` (rescaled to fit the clamp) and its `shelf` (how full the shops keep it). A world's own season records (the DM's Economy tab) still lay their price and shelf over a group's. The clamp's ends (0.80, 1.28), the sell share (0.55) and the backstop (0.95) are constants, never data. `rules` (Core's Rules[] defaults), and `services`, `luxuries`, `houseBusinesses`, `estates` and `wharf`, kept from the city's loop in Phase 3 for the phases that will read them (each `about` names its phase; nothing in Core reads those five yet).

rules.about: The rules' defaults (doc 79, 12; Core/RatwItems.h Rules[] names them, with their ranges): the clamps (neverHungry, neverBroke), the days of food more before a Restday or festival (buyAheadDays), the Board's pressure settings, and staged trade's (Phase 4): the wagons' frequency in percent (caravanRate), the most wagons and farm carts on the roads at once (wagonsOnRoad, cartsOnRoad), a bandit camp's most strength (campStrengthMost) and a bounty's most pennies (bountyMost); and the port's (Phase 5): the ships a week at a port (shipsPerWeek: 0 none, even with a port; its own 2 gives 1-3 a week by the slider and the season, a week running one either side of the rule and fewer in winter). A world's own `rule` records (live.economy.rules) are over these; a name not here or in Rules[] is skipped.

services.about: The city's services (doc 79, 6.5 and 12: kept, at a frequency by band): each a catalogue item (category service) a business does, about once every `every` days a household, `for: patrons` a patron's. Nothing in Core reads them yet: Phase 6 (street life) makes them staged sales at `every` x band; until then a change here, or a world's `service` record (the Rules panel), has no effect in play.

luxuries.about: The luxuries (doc 72, Phase 5: cheese, a comic luxury for wolves): the goods the rich buy. Nothing in Core reads this list yet: the Board's `times` swings their depth group (luxury, by `goods` and `categories` above); Phase 6 (street life) reads it for the rich's staged buying, Phase 8 (talk) for their boasts and complaints.

houseBusinesses.about: The Houses' businesses in the city (doc 72): a business at one of these buildings is its House's. No money moves by it, and nothing in Core reads it yet: the bands find the Houses' people by `houses()` today; Phase 8 (talk) reads this list for who owns what.

estates.about: The Houses' estates (doc 72, Phase 6): each House's people by the words of their posts. No purse (the estates' money went with the city's loop), and nothing in Core reads it: the guarantees (doc 79, 6.3) go by district (the Heights and the estates) since Phase 2. Kept for Phase 8 (talk: a House's people); Phase 9 drops it if talk doesn't take it.

list.name: House Grayrock's estate (the wharf and the sea trade)

wharf.about: The port's goods (doc 79, 8.3 and Phase 5; from doc 73's lists): `never`, goods no ship brings (cheese: the user's); `imports`, what ships bring a port's market, of what its shops set out and its workshops don't make (those goods wait for a ship there: D27); `takes`, what ships take away, of what its shops sell or buy; `ships`, the ships' names (letters and spaces; each passes the forbidden-word check). Core reads them (market::Data's shipBrings, shipTakes, shipNames; World's RatwPort.cpp): a world with no port uses none of it. Atlas's Wharf panel shows the goods until Phase 9 retargets it.
